title.en: Horsepower: Electric 20 Concrete Pump keeps The sheet prints 8–10 m³/h
title.zh: 马力：电动20的订单行要用上每一个已印格子保留「不要把 8–10 改成 20。」

description.en: Electric 20 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-20-concrete-pump. The sheet prints 8–10 m³/h Do not change 8–10 into 20
description.zh: 电动20的订单行要用上每一个已印格子见 /products/electric-20-concrete-pump。不要把 8–10 改成 20。该页印的是 8–10 m³/h。

h1.en: Power to Pump Water is the heading; Electric 20 Concrete Pump stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「功率 到 泵 水」，主体仍是电动20的订单行要用上每一个已印格子

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 20 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-20-concrete-pump. The sheet prints 8–10 m³/h. Do not change 8–10 into 20. The 900 kg figure is weight, not a price. The number matches Tractor-Driven 4100’s hopper. The label is H / V, so 120 m is horizontal and 40 m is vertical. Own 80 mm pipe points at Electric 20’s printed diameter, not at Electric 15. Maximum aggregate if it differs from 1–2 cm, the metres you measured, country and purchase timing. Electric 15 prints 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, pipe 100–125 mm and 450 kg, and it does not print 80 mm or 10 MPa. Add your site voltage and frequency, your measured metres and your stone, and send /en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/ to the contact page. To order the Electric 20 from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, the purchase line is the printed line: 22 kW motor, output 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, hopper 0.25 m³, distance 120 m / 40 m, pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm, frame 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm, weight 900 kg. The section title “Horsepower” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是电动20的订单行要用上每一个已印格子的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-20-concrete-pump。不要把 8–10 改成 20。该页印的是 8–10 m³/h。900 kg 是重量，不是价格。数字与拖拉机带动4100的料斗相同。如果最大骨料不是 1–2 cm，请写上.已有 80 mm 管，对的是电动20印出的管径，不是电动15。标题是 H / V，因此 120 m 是水平，40 m 是垂直。电动15印 15 kW、8–10 m³/h、管径 100–125 mm、450 kg，并且不印 80 mm 或 10 MPa。请加上现场电压和频率、你量到的米数和石子，并把 /zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/ 发到询盘页。向河北品锦机械（邢台）订电动20，采购行就是印出的那一行：电机 22 kW、输送量 8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、料斗 0.25 m³、距离 120 m / 40 m、管径 80 mm、骨料 1–2 cm、外形 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm、重量 900 kg。节标题「马力」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: This section is titled “Horsepower”. Electric 20 Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. The sheet prints 8–10 m³/h. The label is H / V, so 120 m is horizontal and 40 m is vertical. Add your site voltage and frequency, your measured metres and your stone, and send /en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/ to the contact page.
body.zh: 本节标题是「马力」。电动20的订单行要用上每一个已印格子下面这些格子仍是印出来的。电动15印 15 kW、8–10 m³/h、管径 100–125 mm、450 kg，并且不印 80 mm 或 10 MPa。标题是 H / V，因此 120 m 是水平，40 m 是垂直。请加上现场电压和频率、你量到的米数和石子，并把 /zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/ 发到询盘页。

heading.zh: 功率 到 泵 水

body.en: Under “Power to Pump Water”, Electric 20 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. Do not change 8–10 into 20. Own 80 mm pipe points at Electric 20’s printed diameter, not at Electric 15. To order the Electric 20 from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, the purchase line is the printed line: 22 kW motor, output 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, hopper 0.25 m³, distance 120 m / 40 m, pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm, frame 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm, weight 900 kg.
body.zh: 在「功率 到 泵 水」下，电动20的订单行要用上每一个已印格子这一节只放已印出的格子。向河北品锦机械（邢台）订电动20，采购行就是印出的那一行：电机 22 kW、输送量 8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、料斗 0.25 m³、距离 120 m / 40 m、管径 80 mm、骨料 1–2 cm、外形 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm、重量 900 kg。已有 80 mm 管，对的是电动20印出的管径，不是电动15。该页印的是 8–10 m³/h。

body.en: “Shaft or Brake Horsepower” titles this part of the Electric 20 Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. The 900 kg figure is weight, not a price. Maximum aggregate if it differs from 1–2 cm, the metres you measured, country and purchase timing.
body.zh: 「轴功率或制动马力」是电动20的订单行要用上每一个已印格子这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。900 kg 是重量，不是价格。如果最大骨料不是 1–2 cm，请写上.

heading.en: Input Horsepower to the Electrical Motor
heading.zh: 输入 马力 到 电气 电机

body.en: For Electric 20 Concrete Pump, the heading “Input Horsepower to the Electrical Motor” does not replace a cell. The number matches Tractor-Driven 4100’s hopper. Electric 15 prints 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, pipe 100–125 mm and 450 kg, and it does not print 80 mm or 10 MPa. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/horsepower-d_472.html.
body.zh: 对电动20的订单行要用上每一个已印格子而言，标题「输入 马力 到 电气 电机」并不替换任何格子。数字与拖拉机带动4100的料斗相同。不要把 8–10 改成 20。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/horsepower-d_472.html。

question.en: Does “Horsepower” replace The sheet prints 8–10 m³/h?
question.zh: 「马力」会替换「不要把 8–10 改成 20。」吗？

answer.en: No. The sheet prints 8–10 m³/h remains the printed wording for Electric 20 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。不要把 8–10 改成 20。仍是电动20的订单行要用上每一个已印格子已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Do not change 8–10 into 20 belong on the Electric 20 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 电动20的订单行要用上每一个已印格子这一行里，「该页印的是 8–10 m³/h。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-20-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-20-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Power to Pump Water” add to Electric 20 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「功率 到 泵 水」给电动20的订单行要用上每一个已印格子增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/horsepower-d_472.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/horsepower-d_472.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
